title: salvia lanata
intro: Salvia lanata, commonly known as woolly sage, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Salvia genus. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues. The health benefits of Salvia lanata can be attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as sedation, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Salvia lanata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
